parameters.name: CdnType
parameters.description:
The business type of the domain name. Valid values:

- **web**: images and small files.

- **download**: large files.

- **video**: on-demand video and audio streaming.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The domain name that you want to add to CDN.

A wildcard domain name is supported. A wildcard domain name must start with a period (.), for example, .example.com.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the ID of the default resource group.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description:
The acceleration region. Valid values:

- **domestic** (default): Chinese mainland only.

- **overseas**: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

- **global**: global.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. You can specify a maximum of 20 tags.
